The edge of the translucent plastic pocket lacks sharp definition. It bleeds slightly into the blue background with a soft, smeared transition rather than a crisp physical edge or refraction line.
The black spine appears perfectly flat and 2D, lacking the expected cylindrical curvature or thickness variation of a real binder hinge/spine assembly.
